operations.name: categorization.status
operations.summary: Use core categorization with action status for random-forest-categorization.

action.description: Engine action. select/delete/rename need modelId; step/cancel need session; dismiss needs transactionId and suggestionId.

pluginId.description: Stable identifier returned by a read; never a display name.

parameters.description: Plugin-owned training/profile parameters; see the selected categorizer documentation.

transactionId.description: Stable identifier returned by a read; never a display name.

suggestionId.description: Stable identifier returned by a read; never a display name.

output.description: The operation result in the enclosing response data field.

operations.side_effects: Uses the explicit categorization action; model inference/training is optional and never assigns an actual category automatically.
operations.permissions: Authenticated server access to this selected budget over verified HTTPS.
operations.scope: Explicit budget and personal/demo workspace; currencies are never combined.
errors: Invalid or unsupported input is rejected without applying a new decision.
Unavailable feature/storage returns an authored error; stale revisions and reused request IDs with different intent conflict.
operations.retry: Keep the exact request ID, original revision and parameters for an uncertain write; receipts are bounded and restart requires reconciliation.
operations.availability: Delegated core categorization command; not a feature-command. Use command categorization --parameters with the documented action.
